sr-pe.label: Middle-overs economy, spinners who debuted in 2023 or later
sr-pe.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
sr-pe.query: SELECT pl.name, MAX(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mine, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d2 ON d2.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i2 ON i2.innings_id = d2.innings_id JOIN matches m2 ON m2.match_id = d2.match_id WHERE d2.bowler_id = d.bowler_id AND i2.innings_number <= 2 AND d2.over_num BETWEEN 6 AND 14 AND CAST(CASE m2.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m2.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 6 AND 14 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name
